sources.title: Piracy monthly report October 2024
sources.text: While underway, five perpetrators armed with knives boarded from the stern of the ship, and sighted in the engine room. The master raised the alarm and crew was mustered to conduct a search, but no perpetrators were found onboard. Some engine spares were stolen. The crew members were not injured. No further assistance was required by the master and the ship resumed her voyage to China. The master reported the incident to Singapore Vessel Traffic Information System (VTIS). Safety navigational broadcast
